Title: Dynamics 365 Commerce – On-behalf-of support now available in Microsoft Entra External ID
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable on-behalf-of ordering for Microsoft Entra External ID (EEID) in Dynamics 365 Commerce. This feature will reach general availability on September 11, 2026 How does this affect me?
